llm_response.reason: Several scam indicators are present: (1) The domain mimics a legitimate global brand (Sisley) but does not match the official Sisley website, (2) the 'About Us' page uses unrelated boilerplate text referencing sneakers instead of cosmetics, indicating carelessness and possible mass-produced scam templates, (3) no physical address, company registration, or distributor info is provided, (4) the WHOIS data for the domain is unavailable, often used to hide ownership in scams, and (5) an SSL certificate issue was detected, raising security concerns. These facts, together with ambiguous business information and template copying, fit multiple characteristics of fake online shops targeting users with fraudulent offers.
